resources.string: Estimates short-video viewer-page encounters and visible surface time in apps you explicitly enable, using layout identifiers and scroll positions. Facebook additionally uses exact fixed interface-description matches; unmatched descriptions are discarded. TikTok optionally compares visible title/caption fields transiently using in-memory keyed tokens; raw values are discarded. Does not read input or message text, photos or video. Counts and timers stay in encrypted storage on this device. The in-memory session total spans observed apps until screen lock. Optional reminders show a dismissible Attention Stats overlay at your chosen count or time threshold. Separately enabled Reels blocking covers recognized dedicated viewers with an immediate bypass; it does not pause media or audio. Optional counter display has its own switch. Separately allowing experimental auto-scroll and pressing Start on the counter permits numeric playback-progress inspection and an upward swipe after an observed playback loop in supported viewers. Stop remains visible; leaving, locking, pausing observation or hiding the counter stops further swipes. Auto-scroll is off after service restart. Disable observation or blocking at any time in Attention Stats.
